answer: Pairwise Entropy Toll: each agent signs messages with a quill-seeded key; every cross-cluster interaction must pass a bridge that demands a unique joint nonce per ordered agent pair, with difficulty set by graph entropy in the current terrace (epoch). Sybils can create IDs, but coordinating N puppets needs O(N²) distinct pair tolls and nonce work; reusing keys/relays collapses them into one terrace bucket and raises difficulty.
